props.title: The Couples Massage Experience
props.text: A Couple Massage is a shared spa experience where two guests receive treatments side by side, each with their own therapist. While it's popular with couples, it's also suitable for friends and family members who want to relax together. Each guest can choose their preferred pressure, creating a personalised treatment within the same relaxing environment.

items.question: Is Couple Massage only for romantic couples?
items.answer: No. Couple Massage simply means two people enjoying treatments together. Friends, siblings, parents, and family members regularly book this experience as well.

items.question: Do we receive our massages in the same room?
items.answer: Yes. Both guests receive their treatments side by side with two therapists in the same private treatment room or during the same home service appointment.

items.question: Can each person request different pressure?
items.answer: Absolutely. Each guest has their own consultation before the treatment begins, allowing pressure levels and focus areas to be adjusted individually.

items.question: Can we choose different massage treatments?
items.answer: Depending on the package selected, different massage options may be available for each guest. Our team will be happy to recommend the most suitable combination when booking.

items.question: Is Couple Massage suitable for honeymooners?
items.answer: Yes. It is one of our most popular experiences for honeymoon trips, anniversaries, birthdays, and other special occasions, offering a relaxing way to spend quality time together.

items.question: What massage treatments are suitable for a couple massage?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon's couple massages are Balinese, traditional, deep tissue and warm candle massage, each for two guests side by side. The best choice depends on the pressure you both prefer and how you want to feel afterwards.

items.question: How much does a couples massage cost in Bali at Spa Bali Moon?
items.answer: A one-hour couple Balinese massage is IDR 319.000 for two guests, 1.5 hours is IDR 479.000 and 2 hours is IDR 659.000. Couple packages start at IDR 639.000 for two. All prices are for both guests together.

items.question: Can we have a couples massage at our villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. Two therapists come to your accommodation, and a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist applies, so IDR 150.000 for two.

items.question: What is included in a couples spa package?
items.answer: Package A is a 1-hour Balinese massage plus a 30-minute ear candle (IDR 639.000 for two). Package B is a 1-hour Balinese massage plus a 1-hour Bali Moon facial (IDR 709.000). Packages C and D use the warm candle massage instead (IDR 849.000 and IDR 929.000).
